name: @cloudsforge/identity
description: Accounts and authentication: users, profiles, credentials, MFA, sessions, devices, organisations, scoped service tokens and the RS256 signing key. Supersedes Nimbus.
_localDependencies: The @cloudsforge/* packages are consumed from sibling checkouts because none of them is
published yet. Once AD-02 lands they all become registry versions ('^1.0.0') and these paths —
plus the build contexts in the Dockerfile and the extra checkouts in CI — are deleted.
Nothing else in this repository changes.
The runtime packages take 'file:' and contracts-auth takes 'link:', the same split ledger
documents: 'link:' symlinks a contracts package in place so it keeps using the node_modules
its own workspace already installed, which is what a package with first-party transitives
needs. contracts-auth has none today, and taking 'link:' anyway means adding one later is not
jose is a RUNTIME dependency here, unlike in the template and the ledger. Identity is the only
service in the estate that SIGNS: every other service merely verifies, and does so through
@cloudsforge/auth which carries its own copy. Demoting it to a devDependency would produce an
image that boots and then cannot mint a token.
